verdict.rationale: AnyDesk offers a REST API and CLI, so a sandbox or test environment for safely exercising them is a fair question for this product. Nothing in the evidence pack documents a sandbox, test tenant, or dry-run mode isolated from production data. The CLI and API docs describe operations against live clients and sessions only, and the community items are off-topic.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can test against a sandbox environment without touching production data
